title: Engine misfire and rough running
symptoms: Check Engine light on or flashing
possible_causes: Worn or incorrectly gapped spark plugs
Vacuum/air leak after the MAF sensor
diagnosis_steps: Read codes with an OBD2 scanner
Inspect the spark plugs and compare their condition cylinder by cylinder
Swap a coil to another cylinder and see if the misfire follows it
Inspect the intake hoses
fix: Replace spark plugs with the specified type, replace the faulty coil, and clean or replace the injector if needed.
drive_advice: Short distances are OK if the light is steady; avoid driving if it is flashing because it can damage the catalytic converter
text:
Vehicle: BYD F3
System: Engine
Fault: Engine misfire and rough running
Symptoms: Shaking at idle; Weak acceleration; Check Engine light on or flashing; Higher fuel consumption
Possible causes: Worn or incorrectly gapped spark plugs; Weak ignition coils; Damaged coil wiring or connectors; Vacuum/air leak after the MAF sensor; Clogged fuel injector
Diagnosis steps: Read codes with an OBD2 scanner; Inspect the spark plugs and compare their condition cylinder by cylinder; Swap a coil to another cylinder and see if the misfire follows it; Inspect the intake hoses
Fix: Replace spark plugs with the specified type, replace the faulty coil, and clean or replace the injector if needed.
Severity: medium
Can it be driven? Short distances are OK if the light is steady; avoid driving if it is flashing because it can damage the catalytic converter
OBD2 codes: P0300, P0301, P0302, P0303, P0304

title: Hard starting when the engine is cold
symptoms: Starter cranks but engine does not start
diagnosis_steps: Measure battery voltage (should be about 12.4 V or more with the car off)
Listen for the fuel pump priming when the ignition is turned on
Check the ECT reading with a scan tool
fix: Charge or replace the battery, replace the fuel filter or pump, and replace the faulty sensor.
drive_advice: OK as long as it starts, but get it checked soon
text:

Diagnosis steps: Measure battery voltage (should be about 12.4 V or more with the car off); Listen for the fuel pump priming when the ignition is turned on; Check the ECT reading with a scan tool
Fix: Charge or replace the battery, replace the fuel filter or pump, and replace the faulty sensor.
Severity: medium
Can it be driven? OK as long as it starts, but get it checked soon
OBD2 codes: P0117, P0118

title: Oil leak from the valve cover gasket
symptoms: Light smoke from the engine bay
Oil on the side of the engine or around the spark plugs
possible_causes: Valve cover gasket hardened with age and heat
diagnosis_steps: Visually inspect for oil around the valve cover
Check for oil inside the spark plug wells
fix: Replace the valve cover gasket and spark plug tube seals, and clean the area.
drive_advice: OK while monitoring the oil level

title: Excessive oil consumption
symptoms: Blue smoke from the exhaust, especially at start-up or under acceleration
diagnosis_steps: Measure oil loss over a known distance
Inspect the PCV valve
Run a compression test if consumption is high
fix: Clean or replace the PCV valve first, then repair seals or engine internals if needed.
drive_advice: OK while checking the oil level frequently; severe oil loss can destroy the engine
text:

Weak fuel filter or fuel pump
diagnosis_steps: Read fuel trim values with a scan tool
Inspect hoses and connections for leaks
Clean the MAF sensor with a dedicated cleaner
fix: Fix the leak, clean or replace the MAF sensor, and replace the fuel filter.

Engine stalls when stopped at a light
possible_causes: Throttle or pedal position sensor fault
diagnosis_steps: Clean the throttle body with the correct cleaner
Check for air leaks
Read fault codes
fix: Clean the throttle body, perform an idle relearn if the model requires it, and fix any air leak.

title: Engine overheating
diagnosis_steps: Check the coolant level only when the engine is cold
Look for leaks around hoses and the radiator
Confirm the fan runs
Check for bubbles or oil in the coolant
fix: Fix the cause: thermostat, radiator, pump or fan. Oil mixed with coolant points to the head gasket.
drive_advice: Do not keep driving; pull over and switch the engine off to avoid engine damage
text:
Vehicle: BYD F3

Possible causes: Stuck thermostat; Clogged or leaking radiator; Cooling fan not working; Weak water pump; Head gasket failure (serious)
Diagnosis steps: Check the coolant level only when the engine is cold; Look for leaks around hoses and the radiator; Confirm the fan runs; Check for bubbles or oil in the coolant
Fix: Fix the cause: thermostat, radiator, pump or fan. Oil mixed with coolant points to the head gasket.

Can it be driven? Do not keep driving; pull over and switch the engine off to avoid engine damage

title: Radiator fan not working

diagnosis_steps: Check the fuse and relay
Turn on the A/C and see whether the fan spins
Power the motor directly from the battery to test it
fix: Replace the relay, fuse, motor or sensor depending on the cause.
drive_advice: Risk of overheating in traffic; repair quickly

title: Timing belt and drive belts
symptoms: Ticking or squealing from the front of the engine
If the timing belt snaps the engine stops suddenly
possible_causes: Belt has reached the end of its service life
diagnosis_steps: Check the owner's manual for the replacement interval for this model
Visually inspect the belt for cracks or wear
fix: Replace the belt, tensioner and idler, and the water pump at the same time, following the service schedule.
drive_advice: Replace on schedule; a broken belt can cause major engine damage

title: Clutch slipping (manual)
symptoms: Engine revs rise but the car does not accelerate accordingly
Slips especially uphill or in high gears
possible_causes: Worn clutch disc or pressure plate
diagnosis_steps: Do a load test in a high gear
Note whether the clutch engagement point is very high
fix: Replace the clutch kit (disc, pressure plate, release bearing).
drive_advice: OK for a short time but gets worse progressively

Determine whether it happens in all gears or one gear only
fix: Change the gearbox oil, repair the clutch hydraulics, or service the gearbox if synchronizers are worn.
